en: The front side of the postcard shows a sepia-toned photograph of a landscaped square bordered by elegant late-19th-century or early-20th-century buildings, with a large central tree and a fountain. There are trimmed bushes and a few people are visible. The text at the bottom reads 'BAD PYRMONT PARTIE AN DER HAUPTALLEE'. The reverse side displays handwriting in German, a green postage stamp from the 'DEUTSCHES REICH', and a stamp with the words 'MUSEUM IM SCHLOSS BAD PYRMONT'. There is also a manufacturer's name 'Stengel'.
